items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Yeah, it was Chris Ballmer. That's who it was.

ctx.x: Which band was this? Is this Chris Ballmer or which one do you remember?

I think it was, it was the last one year wasn't it? Yeah, it was Chris Ballmer. That's who it was. That's who it was. And that it wasn't, in a way they played pretty nice. But I mean as they tried to play ragtime music, Dixieland is two different music. Everybody don't know that. Dixieland and ragtime, ragtime come out before Dixieland. Now Dixieland was a step up to what you would call jazz. That's another different one. Now like the bands around, plays for instance, what would they call the band, what this guy…
